import unittest
from solution import FrameBuffer

class Probe(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_contract(self):
        buffer = FrameBuffer()
        buffer.feed(b'\x02a')
        view = memoryview(b'b')
        view.release()
        with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
            buffer.feed(view)
        self.assertEqual(buffer.pending, b'\x02a')

if __name__ == '__main__':
    unittest.main()

import unittest

from solution import FrameBuffer


class FrameBufferTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_complete_and_multiple_frames(self):
        buffer = FrameBuffer()
        frames = buffer.feed(b"\x03abc\x02de")
        self.assertEqual(frames, [b"abc", b"de"])
        self.assertTrue(all(type(frame) is bytes for frame in frames))
        self.assertEqual(buffer.pending, b"")

    def test_exact_boundary_frame_is_immediate(self):
        buffer = FrameBuffer()
        self.assertEqual(buffer.feed(b"\x01x"), [b"x"])
        self.assertEqual(buffer.pending, b"")

    def test_zero_length_frames(self):
        buffer = FrameBuffer()
        self.assertEqual(buffer.feed(b"\x00\x00\x01z"), [b"", b"", b"z"])
        self.assertEqual(buffer.pending, b"")

    def test_fragmented_input_and_pending_snapshot(self):
        buffer = FrameBuffer()
        self.assertEqual(buffer.feed(b"\x04ab"), [])
        snapshot = buffer.pending
        self.assertEqual(snapshot, b"\x04ab")
        self.assertIs(type(snapshot), bytes)
        self.assertEqual(buffer.feed(b"cd\x03x"), [b"abcd"])
        self.assertEqual(snapshot, b"\x04ab")
        self.assertEqual(buffer.pending, b"\x03x")
        self.assertEqual(buffer.feed(b"yz"), [b"xyz"])
        self.assertEqual(buffer.pending, b"")

    def test_chunk_is_copied_and_not_mutated(self):
        chunk = bytearray(b"\x02hi")
        before = chunk[:]
        buffer = FrameBuffer()
        self.assertEqual(buffer.feed(chunk), [b"hi"])
        self.assertEqual(chunk, before)
        partial = bytearray(b"\x03a")
        self.assertEqual(buffer.feed(partial), [])
        partial[:] = b"\x00x"
        self.assertEqual(buffer.pending, b"\x03a")
        self.assertEqual(buffer.feed(memoryview(b"bc")), [b"abc"])

    def test_empty_feed(self):
        buffer = FrameBuffer()
        self.assertEqual(buffer.feed(b""), [])
        self.assertEqual(buffer.pending, b"")

    def test_invalid_feed_does_not_change_pending(self):
        buffer = FrameBuffer()
        buffer.feed(b"\x05ab")
        before = buffer.pending
        for chunk in [None, "abc", 3, [1, 2]]:
            with self.subTest(chunk=chunk):
                with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
                    buffer.feed(chunk)
                self.assertEqual(buffer.pending, before)

    def test_instances_do_not_share_buffers(self):
        first = FrameBuffer()
        second = FrameBuffer()
        first.feed(b"\x02a")
        self.assertEqual(first.pending, b"\x02a")
        self.assertEqual(second.pending, b"")
        self.assertEqual(second.feed(b"\x01z"), [b"z"])
        self.assertEqual(first.pending, b"\x02a")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
